label: Crowd captain excess (z, live)
gloss: how far the share of this coin’s cells that are captained sits from the rest of the field’s over the same window, in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells, or when the rest of the field is empty or never or always captains

label: Crowd accuracy edge (z, live)
gloss: how far the crowd’s accuracy on this coin sits from a coin flip (50%), in standard errors — a binomial z by normal approximation, each cell an independent trial; live concurrent sessions excluding the current one; null when none are running; significant at ±1.96, compared unrounded; null with no cells; provisional while the sessions run, an unresolved cell counting as not correct

label: Settled at
gloss: the settlement timestamp of the reference game

label: Flow alignment
gloss: agreement between order flow and crowd positioning — aligned bullish when CVD_state is bullish and upLeanZ is at least 1.96; aligned bearish when CVD_state is bearish and upLeanZ is at most −1.96; divergent when CVD_state is bullish and upLeanZ is at most −1.96, or bearish and upLeanZ is at least 1.96; neutral otherwise; compared on the unrounded score; no value when either is absent

label: Smart vs retail
gloss: divergence between flow pressure and crowd bias — hidden accumulation when buyPres_now > 0.6 and upLeanZ is at most −1.96; hidden distribution when buyPres_now < 0.4 and upLeanZ is at least 1.96; confirmed when buyPres_now > 0.6 and upLeanZ is at least 1.96, or buyPres_now < 0.4 and upLeanZ is at most −1.96; compared on the unrounded score; no value otherwise

label: Captain confidence
gloss: whether captain concentration is confirmed by flow — false when captExcessZ is below 1.96; true when upLeanZ is at least 1.96 with buyPres_trend rising, or upLeanZ is at most −1.96 with buyPres_trend falling; false otherwise; compared on the unrounded scores; no value without captExcessZ or buyPres_trend

label: Convergence confidence
gloss: confidence in the convergence read — high when accEdgeZ is at least 1.96 and buyPres_trend is rising or falling; moderate when one of the two holds; low when neither; compared on the unrounded score; no value without accEdgeZ or buyPres_trend

label: Perp/spot flow
gloss: perp-vs-spot order-flow divergence state from bounded self-normalized CVD rates (shared calculator; crypto coins the spot lane lists) — confirmed_bull when perpSpotGap < 0.1 and both rates are positive; confirmed_bear when perpSpotGap < 0.1 and both rates are negative; spot_led_accumulation when perpSpotGap is at least 0.1 and the spot rate is positive and above the perp rate; perp_led_fragile when perpSpotGap is at least 0.1 and the perp rate is positive and above the spot rate; neutral otherwise and on the bar after the UTC-day reset; compared on the unrounded gap

label: Perp/spot strength
gloss: divergence strength bucket over the bounded perp-vs-spot rate gap (CONFIDENCE idiom) — high at perpSpotGap ≥ 0.5, moderate at ≥ 0.25, low below and on the bar after the UTC-day reset; compared on the unrounded gap, so a gap that prints 0.250 can read low

label: Perp/spot rate gap
gloss: gap between the bounded self-normalized spot and perp CVD rates, |spot rate − perp rate| (0–2), compared unrounded; no value on the bar after the UTC-day reset or where the composite spot tape is unavailable (crypto coins the spot lane lists)

label: Perp/spot confirms
gloss: whether the perp and spot flow rates agree in sign (mutual confirmation)

label: Market · up share
gloss: share of the scope's coins that closed up (%), over the universe it was measured across

label: Market · down share
gloss: share of the scope's coins that closed down (%), over the universe it was measured across

label: Market · net breadth
gloss: net breadth — the up share minus the down share (%), signed; negative is a broadly red field

label: Market · mean change
gloss: mean close-change across the scope (%), signed

label: Market · dispersion
gloss: spread of close-change across the scope (%, standard deviation) — how much the field disagrees; low means the coins moved together and a cohort-wide read describes them, high means the mean hides a wide range and the field is moving further per bar

label: Market · momentum up share
gloss: share of the scope's coins carrying a positive PPO histogram (%), over the coins that have one

label: Market · momentum down share
gloss: share of the scope's coins carrying a negative PPO histogram (%), over the coins that have one

label: Market · net momentum breadth
gloss: net momentum breadth — the positive-histogram share minus the negative (%), signed; negative is a field losing momentum

label: Market · mean PPO histogram
gloss: mean PPO histogram across the scope, signed

label: Market · participation
gloss: mean relative volume across the scope, each coin against its own 20-bar baseline (1.0 = the field at its own normal, 2.0 = twice it) — how much of the field is actually participating; on the stock and commodity scopes it also reads whether the underlying cash session is open, since those perps trade when their underlying markets are shut

label: Market · stretch
gloss: mean RSI(14) across the scope — how extended the field already is, and a slow-moving state rather than a reversal trigger: elevated readings have tended to persist and to run with the move, not against it; the reading is sharpest on the tight crypto cohorts, since averaging the whole tracked universe pulls it toward the midpoint

label: Market · share above EMA 50
gloss: share of the scope's coins closing above their own EMA(50) (%), over the coins whose EMA has warmed — the persistent breadth state: it holds its reading for runs of bars where net breadth flips almost every bar, and its zone reads risk-off at 20 or below and risk-on at 80 or above

label: Market · universe
gloss: the number of the scope's coins the price shares were measured over — the base of every share, published beside it so the base stays visible
